tests.title: An image of FROM base plus OverlayCopyLine runs the copied static agent, which passes the digest check and the Landlock check
given: an engine and both AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_OVERLAY_IMAGE set; the derived part skips when the base variable is unset
a temp context whose Containerfile is exactly "FROM <base>\n" + sandbox.OverlayCopyLine(<overlay>) + "\n"
tests.when: `$CONTAINER build -t agentkit-imgtest-derived-<hex> <temp dir>` runs, the harness starts and attaches to the derived image, Tools is called, and proxy execute runs echo ok, stat -c '%u %a' of the agent and the Landlock probes
then: the build exits 0; Agent().OutlineBackend is "none" and Agent().Version is the expected version
Tools(ctx, sandbox.ToolOptions{}) returns a nil error and a non-empty list, and echo ok prints ok with exit code 0
the copied agent stats as `0 755`, proving the overlay held it owned 0:0 with mode 0755
when Agent().Landlock.ABI is 2 or more, touch /var/tmp/agentkit-probe exits non-zero and touch "$HOME/p" /tmp/p /workspace/p exits 0; otherwise the note is logged
tests.pseudocode:
dir = tmp(); write(dir+'/Containerfile', 'FROM '+base+'\n'+sandbox.OverlayCopyLine(overlay)+'\n')
ref = 'agentkit-imgtest-derived-'+hex(); assert run(engine,'build','-t',ref,dir).code == 0; t.Cleanup(rmi(ref))
sb = harness.start(t, ref); a = sb.Agent(); assert a.OutlineBackend == 'none' && a.Version == expected
ts, err = sb.Tools(ctx, sandbox.ToolOptions{}); assert err == nil && len(ts) > 0
r = exec(sb,'echo ok'); assert r.rc == 0 && trim(r.out) == 'ok' && trim(exec(sb,"stat -c '%u %a' "+AgentPath).out) == '0 755'
assert landlockCheck(a, execVia(sb), t) == nil

h.cleanup()

tests.title: Harness cleanup closes the sandbox and removes the container and every image the test built
given: an engine and both image variables set

then: after the harness cleanup, a proxy call on the closed sandbox fails, and within 10 seconds `$CONTAINER ps -a --filter name=<name> --format {{.Names}}` prints nothing

ref, c = buildDerived(engine, base, overlay); c(); assert run(engine,'image','inspect',ref).code != 0
assert run(engine,'image','inspect',base).code == 0 && run(engine,'image','inspect',overlay).code == 0

tests.title: The cgo stage cross-compiles for the other supported architecture on the build platform
given: an engine and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE set, so this runs only in the opt-in run
the cgo stage name and the binary's source path read from the base stage's `COPY --from=<stage> <src> <AgentPath>`
the other architecture: arm64 when runtime.GOARCH is amd64, else amd64
tests.when: `$CONTAINER build -f sandbox/images/Containerfile --target <cgo stage> --platform linux/<other> --build-arg AGENTKIT_VERSION=v9.8.7 -t agentkit-imgtest-cgo-<hex> .` runs from the repository root, then `create` and `cp` copy <src> out of the image without running it
then: the build exits 0
debug/elf reports the copied file's machine as EM_AARCH64 for arm64 or EM_X86_64 for amd64
debug/buildinfo reports GOOS=linux, GOARCH=<other>, CGO_ENABLED=1, -trimpath=true and -ldflags containing buildver.stamp=v9.8.7
the stage image and the created container are removed in cleanup
tests.pseudocode:
stage, src = cgoCopy(stages(cf)['base']); other = runtime.GOARCH == 'amd64' ? 'arm64' : 'amd64'
ref = 'agentkit-imgtest-cgo-'+hex(); assert run(engine,'build','-f','sandbox/images/Containerfile','--target',stage,'--platform','linux/'+other,'--build-arg','AGENTKIT_VERSION=v9.8.7','-t',ref,'.').code == 0
id = run(engine,'create',ref).out; run(engine,'cp',id+':'+src,tmp+'/agent'); t.Cleanup(rm(id), rmi(ref))
assert elf.Open(tmp+'/agent').Machine == machineFor(other)
bi = buildinfo.ReadFile(tmp+'/agent'); assert bi.setting('GOOS') == 'linux' && bi.setting('GOARCH') == other && bi.setting('CGO_ENABLED') == '1' && bi.setting('-trimpath') == 'true' && has(bi.setting('-ldflags'),'buildver.stamp=v9.8.7')
